criteria.method: Actual preview/LEAF through genuine installed tool interface
criteria.scenario: Open Study, count three parts at sockets; press Practice; verify three tray positions, hidden study labels and zero progress.
Release each matching part within 4 cm of its socket; verify snap and exactly one increment.
Try every wrong part/socket pairing and one outside-region release; verify no progress, lock or completion.
Place all three correctly; verify completion once. Retry release on seated part. Reset independently from Study, Practice and Complete.
